findings.reason: the stale decision record is already marked SUPERSEDED, so the remaining §6/f-dbs-001 measurement node re-derives a settled answer and should be struck or replaced by the wiring the plan actually needs.
findings.text: §6 and followup f-dbs-001 keep "measure the fork-arming economics on catalog frames" as executable work, but the plan's own §coreachability result (commit a9ea090c) already answered it — no frame admits qualified roots of two classes, so the fork is moot and the route is one pinned solve plus post-hoc connectivity classification — and that route already exists as `select_achieved_forward_branch` (nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py:638), used in production at nova/transport/coupled_window.py:1655

findings.reason: §5's "What remains" lists the seed and bootstrap islands but omits the one step that makes the seam live — threading `p_diverted` from `traced_smooth_boundary_read` into the host selector — so the plan should either name that wiring or extend the existing host selector instead of leaving a placeholder-fed wrapper.
findings.text: the seam's smooth weight is unreachable from production: both host entry points `select_forward_branch` (line 624) and `select_achieved_forward_branch` (line 670) build `TracedSelectionInput` with `p_diverted=jnp.asarray(0.5)` and `class_margin=jnp.asarray(jnp.nan)`, and a repository-wide search finds `forward_branch_selection_input`/`scan_forward_branch_selection` consumed only by tests/test_branch_selection.py and the benchmark, so the "continuous selection" exists only on the traced path no caller wires.

findings.reason: the plan's design should name nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py as the single owner of the seam and retire or explicitly demote the benchmark copy, otherwise the artefact the plan cites for continuity is a parallel implementation of the function the plan just promoted.
findings.text: a second `traced_select_forward_branch` is defined beside the production one at nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py:507, with the same name and a divergent blend (`0.5 * (p_weight + margin_weight)` against the production `p_diverted`-only weight), and the plan lists this benchmark among its artifacts; its own docstring still asserts "The production selector is deliberately unchanged", which the c64440e8 landing falsified.

findings.reason: the section must account for the public names it introduces — the supplied counts are public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0 — by naming what folds into the existing host selector or why the surface cannot be smaller.
findings.text: §5 adds a public traced selection surface (the `nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py` exports — `TracedSelectionInput`, `traced_select_forward_branch`, `scan_forward_branch_selection`, `forward_branch_selection_input`, `select_achieved_forward_branch` and the receipt/policy/history types) without naming any definition it retires or merges, and without stating why nothing can be.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the seam at nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py hides the host history machine, the traced transition and the flux blend behind `select_forward_branch`/`traced_select_forward_branch`, and the host selector delegates its transition semantics to the array core rather than reimplementing them.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — `benchmarks/traced_selection_seam.py:51` defines a second `traced_select_forward_branch` duplicating the production owner at nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py:507 with a different blend, and the plan still names it as an artifact.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §5 promotes "one public, traced, batched seam" without naming what it retires or merges, or stating why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan re-runs fork-arming economics in §6 and f-dbs-001 although its own class-coreachability node (a9ea090c) concluded a single pinned solve with post-hoc classification, whose mechanism already ships as `select_achieved_forward_branch` (nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py:638, consumed at nova/transport/coupled_window.py:1655), and the plan never cites it.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: a finding — the continuous seam is a thin layer over `p_diverted`, which `traced_smooth_boundary_read` already emits (nova/equilibrium/connectivity_boundary.py:2424), and no production caller supplies it: both host entry points hardcode `p_diverted=0.5`, `class_margin=NaN`.
